balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.description: Validated low-energy departure. A two-kilometre rotor releases the capsule at 1.00 km/s; a fictional ascent stage adds 9.923817 km/s prograde.
balanced.verificationNote: Reproducible: departure at 6,571 km with 10.923817 km/s prograde, fixed 4 s step. The capsule enters the 12,000 km lunar reception zone at about 3.59 days. See MODEL_NOTES.md.
